title: 光路溫度漂移補償
summary: 從漂移量測、熱串擾與穩定回授拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate drift sensing, thermal crosstalk and stable feedback, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設共振溫度斜率 80 pm/K，環境變化 3 K 產生 240 pm 漂移；假設加熱器斜率 40 pm/mW，要反向補償 240 pm 需相對原偏壓減少 6 mW。若原偏壓僅 4 mW，單純加熱器無法完成此負向補償。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 80 pm/K resonance drift and a 3 K change: 240 pm. With 40 pm/mW heater slope, opposing this shift requires reducing bias by 6 mW. A 4 mW initial bias cannot supply that negative correction.
workedExample.assumptions: 局部線性且固定偏振；這組斜率是假想值，沒有代表特定製程。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local linearity and fixed polarization; slopes are hypothetical, not a process specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
